notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1959 volume. Curated: the Golden Gate Park tennis and bowling clubhouses, the Hall of Flowers contract, Jackson Playground and McCoppin Square rehabilitations, Storyland's designer, and namings (duPont courts, Johnston clubhouse, Walter S. Johnson at the Palace of Fine Arts).

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the John J. Condon Handball Courts naming (no page), the Hunters Point Gymnasium rehabilitation and Candlestick Park parking and dedication matters (no page).

findings.address_as_written: Tennis Courts between California and Clement Streets, bounded by 30th and 31st Avenues
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission renamed the tennis courts between California and Clement Streets and 30th and 31st Avenues the Margaret Osborne duPont Playground, for the world tennis champion who had learned the game on the city's public courts.
